Trains to Swansea

This is the train I would look at for the Wales National Airshow. Swansea station is right in the city centre. GWR runs direct trains from London Paddington via Reading, Bristol Parkway, Newport and Cardiff, and Transport for Wales runs along the South Wales main line and west to Llanelli and Carmarthen. In 2026 there were engineering works on the airshow weekend, so I would check for changes before you travel.
